set.body: Implement LISA as a local-adaptive post-statistic inference engine that shares neurothresh's regularized infrastructure. Core contract: lisa(null_spec, ...) consumes a neurothresh_null_spec whose stat_vol is canonicalized, draw(b) yields matched null maps, and n_perm/mask come from the spec by default. Return neurothresh_result, use tail = pos/neg/two, and keep LISA independent from scale_space_energy: LISA asks which voxels have locally supported adaptive-filter evidence at FDR control; scale_space_energy asks what spatial resolution supports distributed evidence. Source plan: specs/lisa-plan.md.
set.title: Epic: LISA local adaptive inference
